name: Serve routine ladder against a wall
summary: Alone at a wall, the same pre-serve routine before every serve, climbing a ladder of serves in a row over a net-height line.
setup: Tape a line on the wall about 0.9 m above the floor (the net) and a floor line about 6 m from the wall (the baseline)
Before every serve run the same short routine: feet set, one breath, look at the target, serve
Ladder: 3 serves in a row over the line, then 5, then 7; a fault (below the line, a mis-hit or a foot on or over the floor line) restarts the current rung
success_criterion: Complete the 3-5-7 ladder (15 serves over the line) with at most 3 restarts
safety_notes: Low intensity. Keep clear space around you for rebounds and do not chase them. Stop if your shoulder or wrist hurts.
coach_rationale: (judgment) A fixed routine and serves-in-a-row pressure build a serve that holds when points count: fewer serve faults (AN-05) and more rallies started on your serve (AN-01). The ladder makes consistency countable alone. The fault rules are UNVERIFIED in this app (P7): count them as your rules allow. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
